name: 2.5D Photometric Studio configures light direction, material shaders, and bakes tangent normal maps
description: Verify drawing on canvas, opening PixiBud AI to configure 2.5D Photometric Studio in Manual mode, selecting Gold / Brass material, baking photometric lighting, baking a normal map, and verifying the Normal Map layer appears in the Layers panel.

planSteps.description: Click the drawing canvas to draw an initial shape on Base Layer
Click the 'PixiBud AI' tab button in the right inspector panel (data-testid tab-ai)
Verify the 2.5D Photometric Studio section is visible with Auto and Manual modes
Click the 'Layers' tab button in the right inspector panel (data-testid tab-layers)
Verify the layer stack displays the created 'Normal Map' layer
